description: Parses raw cell input text into a typed value, mirroring how Excel / OnlyOffice interpret what the user types. Recognises (in priority order): forced text (leading apostrophe), formulas (=), booleans, percentages, currency, numbers and dates/times — all culture-aware. Also derives an implied number format (e.g. 0%, #,##0.00) which the caller applies only when the target cell still uses the General format.

members.name: Parse
members.description: Parses input using culture for number/date conventions.
